features.title: A complete modular workshop
features.description: Load Ironbrook blacksmith from Example scenes, or search blacksmith for thirteen original pieces. Hide roofs to arrange the forge, anvil, workbench, trough and tools.

features.title: Connect the building to your world
features.description: Floors and walls use integrated OpenLOCK sockets. The removable roof rests on the walls; furnishings stand directly on the floor without added connector bases.
